comparison.objective: Spread a sprung delta-printer arm pair and fit its sockets over effector ball studs; candidate tunes a hydraulic damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR requires holding two arms apart against spring force while aligning two sockets and moving an effector into them. Candidate requires small-tool insertion, screw/collar manipulation, socket reacquisition, and impact-response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires both ball sockets seated, effector flat, hands clear, and 1 s stability. Candidate requires two bounded-energy carriage stops without travel, force, rebound, or retention faults.
comparison.reason: Spring-loaded dual-socket assembly and hydraulic commissioning test different physical abilities and outcomes.
